topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The package arrived, unexpectedly, its dimensions long and thin, wrapped in a layer of brown paper with scrawled handwriting that wasn't mine. I hesitated, my fingers brushing the tape, thinking of the hands that had packed it, the anticipation of its intended recipient, someone who no longer lives here. It seemed wrong, almost intrusive, to open it. Yet, a part of me wondered—what if it was something important, something that needed to find its way back to them? I decided to hold on to it, to see if the former tenant might return or if, in some way, I could pass it along. It sits now on my kitchen table, a silent reminder, a misplaced piece in a puzzle I never completed.
